mapper.sql: U.USER_NUMB , U.USER_NICK , U.INTR_CNTN , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , CASE WHEN U.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS ME_YSNO , CASE WHEN U.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} THEN NULL WHEN USERFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND REVERSEFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN FN_GET_CODE_NAME_LANG(#{codeFollowStat}, #{followStatFriend}, NULL, #{englishYsno}) WHEN USERFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN FN_GET_CODE_NAME_LANG(#{codeFollowStat}, #{followStatFollowing}, NULL, #{englishYsno}) WHEN REVERSEFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN FN_GET_CODE_NAME_LANG(#{codeFollowStat}, #{followStatBothFolw}, NULL, #{englishYsno}) ELSE FN_GET_CODE_NAME_LANG(#{codeFollowStat}, #{followStatFollow}, NULL, #{englishYsno}) END AS FOLLOW_STAT_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT /* getFollowStatusName */ CASE WHEN USERFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND REVERSEFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN FN_GET_CODE_NAME_LANG(#{codeFollowStat}, #{followStatFriend}, NULL, #{englishYsno}) WHEN USERFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN FN_GET_CODE_NAME_LANG(#{codeFollowStat}, #{followStatFollowing}, NULL, #{englishYsno}) WHEN REVERSEFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN FN_GET_CODE_NAME_LANG(#{codeFollowStat}, #{followStatBothFolw}, NULL, #{englishYsno}) ELSE FN_GET_CODE_NAME_LANG(#{codeFollowStat}, #{followStatFollow}, NULL, #{englishYsno}) END AS FOLLOW_STAT_NAME FROM ( SELECT #{userNumb} AS USER_NUMB , #{flowNumb} AS FLOW_NUMB ) TARGET LEFT JOIN TB_FOLLOW USERFOLLOW ON USERFOLLOW.USER_NUMB = TARGET.USER_NUMB AND USERFOLLOW.FLOW_NUMB = TARGET.FLOW_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_FOLLOW REVERSEFOLLOW ON REVERSEFOLLOW.USER_NUMB = TARGET.FLOW_NUMB AND REVERSEFOLLOW.FLOW_NUMB = TARGET.USER_NUMB

SELECT /* getLikeDtl */ R.TAGT_TYPE , R.TAGT_NUMB , COALESCE(LC.LIKE_CNT, 0) AS LIKE_CNT , COALESCE(UL.LIKE_YSNO, #{commNo}) AS LIKE_YSNO FROM ( SELECT #{tagtType} AS TAGT_TYPE , #{tagtNumb} AS TAGT_NUMB ) R LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_TYPE , L.TAGT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM TB_LIKEXX L INNER JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND L.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = L.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) ) GROUP BY L.TAGT_TYPE, L.TAGT_NUMB ) LC ON LC.TAGT_TYPE = R.TAGT_TYPE AND LC.TAGT_NUMB = R.TAGT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_TYPE , L.TAGT_NUMB , #{commYes} AS LIKE_YSNO FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND L.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND L.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ) UL ON UL.TAGT_TYPE = R.TAGT_TYPE AND UL.TAGT_NUMB = R.TAGT_NUMB

SELECT /* getUserSearchList */
FROM TM_USERXM U LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_FOLLOW USERFOLLOW ON USERFOLLOW.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} AND USERFOLLOW.FLOW_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_FOLLOW REVERSEFOLLOW ON REVERSEFOLLOW.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB AND REVERSEFOLLOW.FLOW_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} WHERE U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} AND U.USER_NUMB != #{loginUserNumb} AND INSTR(U.USER_NICK, #{keyword}) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb}) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN USERFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL AND REVERSEFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN 0 WHEN USERFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL OR REVERSEFOLLOW.USER_NUMB IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END , U.USER_NICK , U.USER_NUMB LIMIT #{pageOffset}, #{pageLimit}

SELECT /* getLikeUserList */
FROM TB_LIKEXX LIKES INNER JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = LIKES.USER_NUMB AND U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON F.FILE_NUMB = U.PROF_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_FOLLOW USERFOLLOW ON USERFOLLOW.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} AND USERFOLLOW.FLOW_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TB_FOLLOW REVERSEFOLLOW ON REVERSEFOLLOW.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB AND REVERSEFOLLOW.FLOW_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} WHERE LIKES.TAGT_TYPE = #{tagtType} AND LIKES.TAGT_NUMB = #{tagtNumb} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{loginUserNumb}) ) ORDER BY LIKES.REGI_DATE DESC , U.USER_NUMB DESC LIMIT #{pageOffset}, #{pageLimit}
